verdict.rationale: Ghostty exposes programmatic surfaces: the libghostty C/Zig library, an AppleScript dictionary and +action CLI commands. So API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning, stability guarantees or a deprecation policy for any of these surfaces, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
